context: Sho and Hina prepare for a school trip.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、本当、明日、修学旅行、ね。
lines.en: Hina, tomorrow's the school trip, right?
lines.style: Quiet, almost tentative. Small voice carrying genuine anticipation. Soft peak on 'trip' — not pushing for excitement, just checking the reality of it with her. Warm thread underneath.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、本当、楽しみ、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah — I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Bright and open, no hesitation. That pure eight-year-old certainty. Warm light in the voice, steady throughout. Real joy without trying to perform it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: We'll have so much fun together.
lines.style: Soft and sincere. Six-year-old simplicity stating something true. No performance — just the gentle certainty of a small boy who knows something good is coming. Warm but modest.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact tone with undertones of belonging. That satisfied eight-year-old certainty. Open delivery, no strain. Real childish warmth — comfortable in her world.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm going to do my best.
lines.style: Small determination underneath the softness. Sho's quiet way of saying something that matters to him. Not loud conviction — steady, real, the way a six-year-old makes a promise to himself. Warm resolve.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Light, unselfconscious joy. Eight-year-old honesty — she isn't afraid to say what she feels. Warm and open throughout, with a small lift at the end like she's surprised at her own happiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I really am looking forward to it.
lines.style: Quieter now, more inward. The small sincerity of a six-year-old speaking something true mostly to himself. Soft throughout, warm at the core. A gentle landing — not building, just settling into the feeling.
